title: Chapter 7200: Be The Main Character
content:
Chapter 7200: Be The Main Character

Chapter 7200: Be The Main Character

Phoenix Queen, Octopus, Heavenfall, and Genesis no longer existed. The powers from the future have returned as well.

When immortals looked up at Li Qiye, time came to a halt. They could see hope again.

He grabbed Heavencrush and it struggled like a crab attempting to break free.

“Play nice, the mortal world does not need you. Wait for the right time and the summon.” Li Qiye said.

He tapped it and turned it into a box with a gentle glow, seemingly having evolved. He then tossed it far, far away. It would only appear with a summon when truly needed.

Li Qiye then teleported next to Duality Master and said: “See, suffering doesn’t feel great. Only when you try will you know your talent and limit.”

Duality Master had an ugly smile, unable to speak due to the tribulations piercing through his body.

“Bam!” Li Qiye smacked him, repelling the tribulations.

The bolts roared and attempted to swallow him. Alas, he caught and obliterated them with both hands.

Finally, he raised his hands and sealed the gate above, preventing more bolts from descending.

Before anyone could react, he forcefully rearranged Heavenrealm, rebuilding the shattered worlds. Primordial trees stood strong in each and arranged themselves into a chapter. The content was empty, reserved for the inhabitants of this world to decide.

Nonetheless, he signed his name to initiate this new chapter, making it eternal and unbreakable.

“Old man, your signature is ugly.” Duality Master laughed.

“You can write then.” Li Qiye stopped.

“Uhh...” Duality Master looked at the chapter and got a headache: “Nope, still your business, I don’t want to steal your thunder.”

“Pop!” Li Qiye smacked his head and said: “Don’t make excuses for your lack of ability.”

“Didn’t you see how strong I was just now? I was insane, superior to anyone else by borrowing all living beings’ powers. No one else could have done it.” He complained.

“Sure, but that’s their powers, not yours.” Li Qiye said.

“Sigh, you’re just too picky, nothing in this world can be perfect, I did a great job by stopping those bolts. You wouldn’t be able to find a better man.” He said.

“Don’t push it.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Is it that hard to praise me, old man? You won’t lose anything.” He said.

“Fine, you are so strong.” Li Qiye smiled: “Sigh, lying isn’t easy.”

“That works for me since you said the words.” He came closer and rubbed shoulders with Li Qiye: “I’m kind of a big shot now, you have to give me face.”

“Big shot?” Li Qiye pushed him away.

“Old man, someone like me is the main character wherever I go.” He said confidently.

“You’re the main character here?” Li Qiye stared with disdain.

“Forget it, you can be the main character since it’s too much of a hassle. I’ll just open a new world later and be the main character.” He said.

“Bam!” Li Qiye smacked his head again and said: “Nice fantasy, focus on your dao heart first.”

“I’m done being near you, you’re ruining my youth.” He grabbed his head and angrily said before leaving: “Don’t want to see you again!”

Li Qiye smiled and focused on the world and the primordial glow stemming from the trees.

“The worlds are one, eternal lord.” Immortals sensed the changes in Heavenrealm.

They knelt to show Li Qiye the highest reverence for fixing the worlds and immortals.

“Pop!” Li Qiye paid them no mind and disappeared into the primordial where Li Baye awaited.

The two sat opposite as Li Baye complained: “Why can’t I just do nothing? You’re forcing my hand.”

“The choice is yours.” Li Qiye smiled.

“How can I when your dao heart is still here. Whenever things go wrong, I’ll have to clean up the mess for this world.” He said.

“You’ve been relaxing for quite a bit already.” Li Qiye said.

“And I want to do it for my whole life. When I wanted to be a mortal, you didn’t let me and dragged me up to be a dao lord.” He complained.

“Then resist to achieve your goal.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Bullshit, if I could resist your dao heart, I would be able to pierce the heaven. Why would I focus on lifting a boulder instead of actual achievable things?” He jumped up and cursed.
